(()=>{'use strict';const C=VeredaStay,$=s=>document.querySelector(s),money=n=>(n/100).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});let session=null,cart={},orders=[],serial=0;
const names={lumina:'Lumina',stays:'Stays',prive:'Privé'},model=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('modelo');$('#stay-brand').textContent=names[model]||'Vereda';$('#back-model').href=(Object.hasOwn(names,model)?model:'lumina')+'.html';
function text(tag,value){const el=document.createElement(tag);el.textContent=value;return el;}function button(label,fn){const el=text('button',label);el.type='button';el.addEventListener('click',fn);return el;}
function render(){ $('#session').textContent=session?'Estadia demonstrativa · acomodação 12':'Entre na estadia de exemplo para experimentar';$('#login').hidden=!!session;$('#logout').hidden=!session;$('#checkout').disabled=!session||!Object.keys(cart).length;$('#cart').replaceChildren();let total=0;for(const [id,qty]of Object.entries(cart)){const item=C.menu.find(x=>x.id===id),line=document.createElement('div');line.append(text('span',qty+' × '+item.name+' · '+money(item.cents*qty)),button('Remover '+item.name,()=>{delete cart[id];render();}));$('#cart').append(line);total+=qty*item.cents;}$('#total').textContent=money(total);
for(const [selector,role]of [['#guest-orders','guest'],['#kitchen-orders','kitchen'],['#management-orders','management']]){const box=$(selector);box.replaceChildren();if(!orders.length)box.append(text('p','Nenhum pedido nesta simulação.'));for(const o of orders){const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='order';card.append(text('h3','Pedido '+o.id+' · Acomodação '+o.room),text('p',o.lines.map(x=>x.qty+' × '+x.name).join(' / ')),text('strong',o.status.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+o.status.slice(1)));if(role!=='kitchen')card.append(text('p',money(o.total)+' · valor ilustrativo'));const change=status=>{orders=orders.map(x=>x.id===o.id?C.transition(x,status):x);render();$('#status').textContent='Pedido '+o.id+': '+status+'.';};if(role==='kitchen'&&C.next[o.status])card.append(button({preparando:'Iniciar preparo',pronto:'Marcar pronto',entregue:'Confirmar entrega'}[C.next[o.status]],()=>change(C.next[o.status])));if(role==='guest'&&o.status==='recebido')card.append(button('Cancelar pedido '+o.id,()=>change('cancelado')));box.append(card);}}
$('#summary').textContent=orders.filter(x=>x.status!=='cancelado').length+' pedidos ativos ou entregues · '+money(orders.filter(x=>x.status!=='cancelado').reduce((n,x)=>n+x.total,0))+' em consumo demonstrativo. Não é cobrança.';}
C.menu.forEach(item=>{const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='dish';card.append(text('span','CARDÁPIO ILUSTRATIVO'),text('h3',item.name),text('p',item.description),text('strong',money(item.cents)),button('Adicionar '+item.name,()=>{cart[item.id]=Math.min(10,(cart[item.id]||0)+1);render();$('#status').textContent=item.name+' adicionado.';}));$('#menu').append(card);});
$('#login').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();if($('#code').value.trim().toUpperCase()!=='DEMO12'){$('#login-status').textContent='Use apenas o código demonstrativo DEMO12.';return;}session={active:true,room:'12'};$('#login-status').textContent='';render();});$('#logout').addEventListener('click',()=>{session=null;cart={};orders=[];render();$('#status').textContent='Sessão de exemplo encerrada e pedidos apagados.';});$('#checkout').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{orders.push(C.order(cart,session,String(++serial).padStart(3,'0')));cart={};render();$('#status').textContent='Pedido simulado recebido. Abra a visão da cozinha para acompanhar o preparo.';}catch(e){$('#status').textContent=e.message;}});document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-screen]').forEach(s=>s.hidden=s.dataset.screen!==b.dataset.view);document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(x===b)));}));render();})();
